playbook.title: Active playbook
playbook.description: The id of the playbook that was active when this message was sent (absent if none).

sessionId.title: Session ID
sessionId.description: Built-in: ULID identifying which lifecycle session this message belongs to.

sessionNumber.title: Session Number
sessionNumber.description: Built-in: Session sequence number, increments each time the conversation session expires.

studyxOutboundId.title: StudyX outbound ID
studyxOutboundId.description: Stable outbound identifier committed by StudyX and attached to the Botpress message.

studyxTraceId.title: StudyX trace ID
studyxTraceId.description: End-to-end correlation ID without customer content.

adkSyncTs.title: ADK Sync Timestamp
adkSyncTs.description: Built-in: Last synced message timestamp. Automatically updated by the ADK when messages are processed.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Set to "true" to enable debug recording for this conversation.

debugToken.title: Debug stream token
debugToken.description: Capability JWT for live debug streaming to viber-sync. Set by viber-api on preview conversations; absent on production traffic.

preview.title: Builder preview
preview.description: Set to "true" when the conversation is a builder/UI preview (the preview pane), not real end-user traffic.

sessionExpired.title: Session Expired
sessionExpired.description: Built-in: Set to "true" when a conversation session expires via lifecycle management.

status.title: Conversation status
status.description: LLM-assessed status of the conversation: pending, resolved, unresolved, abandoned, or spam.

title.title: Conversation title
title.description: Short auto-generated display title for the conversation, refreshed as the conversation grows.

version.title: Definition slot
version.description: Which definition slot to execute against: "draft" (preview) or "published" (default — real-user traffic).

memoryRefresh.description: Fires after the user has been silent for a while so the runtime can refresh user memory without ending or clearing the conversation.

statusEvaluation.description: Fires after the conversation has been idle so the runtime can evaluate and tag its status (pending/resolved/unresolved/abandoned/spam).

addWebsitePageToDraft.title: Add Website Page to Draft Knowledge
addWebsitePageToDraft.description: Upload a crawled webpage into the Master knowledge base as a draft entry. Used by the website-indexing workflow.

url.description: Canonical URL of the page being added.

claimBatch.title: Claim StudyX inbound batch
claimBatch.description: Takes ownership of one inbound batch and returns its controlled context.

generateQuestionsFromConversations.title: Generate Questions From Conversations
generateQuestionsFromConversations.description: Scan recent conversations (end-user traffic and preview chats) and extract distinct knowledge questions to use as question tests. Returns candidates only — nothing is saved.

ingestTurn.title: Ingest StudyX turn
ingestTurn.description: Persists one external inbound event and returns the canonical StudyX context.

lookupCatalog.title: Look up StudyX catalog
lookupCatalog.description: Reads the current, structured product catalog. Read-only.

reportDelivery.title: Report StudyX delivery state
reportDelivery.description: Records Botpress submission or failure without claiming provider delivery.

startSimulationBatch.title: Start Simulation Batch
startSimulationBatch.description: Resolve simulations from the agent definition and start a batch workflow that runs them in parallel. Returns the batch workflow id.

version.description: Which definition slot to read simulations from and run against.

simulationIds.description: Subset of simulation ids to run.

kind.description: Run only simulations of this kind.

playbookId.description: Run only the flow tests associated to this playbook.

concurrency.description: How many runs execute at once.

batchId.description: Id of the started SimulationBatch workflow run.

total.description: How many simulations the batch will run.

syncWebsiteKnowledge.title: Sync Website Knowledge
syncWebsiteKnowledge.description: Reconcile an explicit website-knowledge patch for a draft or published definition slot.

revision.description: Definition revision that emitted this command. Optional only for rolling-deploy compatibility.

urls.description: Exact desired URL set. Omit to leave website knowledge untouched; [] explicitly clears it.

changed.description: Whether an explicit website reconciliation was scheduled.

desired.description: Number of URLs in the explicit desired set.

workflowId.description: Durable reconciliation or follow-up workflow id.

queued.description: Whether the command is waiting for an active reconciliation.

transcribeAudio.title: Transcribe an inbound audio message
transcribeAudio.description: Downloads an audio file from the source provider and returns the transcribed text via Gemini.
